title.en: What Was Known on That Date?

hints.tr: `value = None` ile başla; `for when, known in history:` içinde `if when <= day: value = known`.
hints.en: Start with `value = None`; inside `for when, known in history:` write `if when <= day: value = known`.

hints.tr: Tarihler `YYYY-MM-DD` olduğu için metin karşılaştırması zaman sırasını verir. İlk büyük tarihte `break`.
hints.en: Since dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, text comparison gives time order. `break` at the first later date.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def as_of(history, day):
    value = None
    for when, known in history:
        if when <= day:
            value = known
        else:
            break
    return value


history = [["2026-01-01", 0], ["2026-02-01", 1], ["2026-03-01", 4]]
print(as_of(history, "2026-02-15"))
print(as_of(history, "2026-03-01"))
print(as_of(history, "2025-12-31"))
print(as_of([], "2026-01-01"))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def as_of(history, day):
    value = None
    for when, known in history:
        if when <= day:
            value = known
        else:
            break
    return value


history = [["2026-01-01", 0], ["2026-02-01", 1], ["2026-03-01", 4]]
print(as_of(history, "2026-02-15"))
print(as_of(history, "2026-03-01"))
print(as_of(history, "2025-12-31"))
print(as_of([], "2026-01-01"))
```
